items.exampleEn: People can write to the government about their ideas.
items.exampleZh: 人們可以寫信給政府，說出自己的想法。

items.exampleEn: He reads political news every morning.
items.exampleZh: 他每天早上都看政治新聞。

items.exampleEn: Many members of the public came to the meeting.
The police stopped the car on the highway.
items.exampleZh: 警察在公路上把那輛車攔了下來。

items.exampleEn: There is a military airport near my town.
items.exampleZh: 我家附近有一座軍用機場。
我們的社會越來越高齡化。

items.exampleEn: The official language of Brazil is Portuguese.
items.exampleZh: 巴西的官方語言是葡萄牙語。

items.sentenceEn: There is a police car outside our school.
items.sentenceZh: 我們學校外面有一輛警車。

items.audioEn: The museum is open to the public from nine to five.
items.audioZh: 博物館從九點到五點開放給大眾參觀。
items.questionZh: 博物館什麼時候開放給大眾？

items.sentenceZh: 每個人都必須遵守法律。

items.sentenceEn: Please check the official website for more information.
items.sentenceZh: 更多資訊請查看官方網站。

items.stemEn: If you see someone stealing a bike, call the ____.
items.stemZh: 如果你看到有人在偷腳踏車，就打電話報警。

items.stemEn: My grandfather wore a ____ uniform when he was young.
items.stemZh: 我爺爺年輕時穿過軍服。

items.passageEn: Our town has a new library. The local government built it last year, and it is open to the public every day. You can find more information on its official website. My uncle works there. He says the library is good for society because everyone can read and learn for free. Next month, a police officer will come and teach children about traffic laws.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上有一間新圖書館。地方政府去年蓋好，每天都開放給大眾使用。更多資訊可以在它的官方網站上找到。我叔叔在那裡工作。他說圖書館對社會很有幫助，因為每個人都能免費閱讀和學習。下個月，會有一位警察來教小朋友交通規則。

questions.questionZh: 下個月圖書館會有什麼活動？
options: 警察教小朋友交通規則

referenceEn: She studies political science at university.
She is studying political science at university.
rubricZh: 「政治學」可寫，例如 political science、politics 等
時態可寫例如 studies、is studying

items.instructionZh: 用 society 造一個句子，說說社會上的一個現象，或社會需要什麼。
referenceEn: Many people in our society use phones all day.
Our society needs more parks for children.
rubricZh: society 指「社會」（例如 our society、in society）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 Our society needs）
